description: Create an email inbox an agent can receive mail at (private beta — answers `inboxes_not_enabled` if the project isn't in it). Omit `domain` for an address on the shared domain, usable immediately. Pass a `clientId` (e.g. your agent's name) so calling this again returns the same inbox instead of making another — addresses are permanent and never recycled. Then wait for mail with volanea_wait_for_email and read conversations with volanea_read_inbox. This server never sends from an inbox; replies go through POST /v1/inboxes/{inboxId}/messages/{emailId}/reply in the user's code.

displayName.description: From name on mail sent from this inbox.

domain.description: A verified domain of the project whose MX points at SES (use a subdomain like agents.company.com). Omit for the shared domain.

username.description: Local part of the address. Random if omitted.

name: volanea_create_inbox

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

address.description: The email address to give out.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
